mapper.insert: insert into itm_notify_log (channel_id, channel_name, channel_type, event, title, content, status, error, sent_at) values (#{channelId}, ifnull(#{channelName}, ''), ifnull(#{channelType}, ''), ifnull(#{event}, ''), ifnull(#{title}, ''), ifnull(#{content}, ''), #{status}, ifnull(#{error}, ''), #{sentAt})
mapper.delete: delete from itm_notify_log where sent_at < #{before} limit #{limit}
